facts.fact: The Ministry of Information Technology launched the Motor Vehicle Licence system on 17 August 2026, letting taxi operators renew licences and pay Road Tax online; online driving licence and penalty-point services are on the KOREK super app.
facts.system: Motor Vehicle Licence System; KOREK super app
